title: US issues advisory to 'reconsider travel' to Saudi Arabia
summary: WASHINGTON — The United States embassy on Tuesday issued an advisory to “reconsider travel” to Saudi Arabia after Riyadh issued alerts in Mecca and other areas amid Houthi attacks.…

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — The United States embassy on Tuesday issued an advisory to “reconsider travel” to Saudi Arabia after Riyadh issued alerts in Mecca and other areas amid Houthi attacks. The advisory warns of the “risk of Iranian drone and missile targeting of American interests, armed conflict, terrorism, exit bans and local laws regarding social media activity,” adding “Do Not Travel to the Yemen border due to threat of terrorism.” /dl READ: US embassies urge citizens to consider departing Middle East...
